name: super-set
description: Ready-made ways of working for Claude Code: plugins that set up a project so Claude plans first, proves its work, and keeps notes between sessions.

plugins.name: app-project-workflow
plugins.description: For software projects: sets up a PRD, a work board, session notes, and a checked ticket flow (plan, build, test, review) so Claude proves its work and stays in scope.

plugins.name: content-project-workflow
plugins.description: For video, animation, and content projects: sets up a brief, style guide, reference list, approval gates, and agents that build, check frames, and research, so Claude follows your references and shows designs before building on them.
